item.description:
Formula 0.1.54

  • Ideas: a plan written before Formula closed is checked, not written again (#103)
  • Support: nothing to sign in to. It opens with your Google sign-in, and the old Intercom sign-in is removed (#101)
  • Ideas: builds on the Mac install the photo editor's public trial copy, so the websites' tests run without a key (#100)
  • The classic screens are gone: Formula is one set of screens on Mac and PC, with Settings, the menu bar and notifications opening the right page (#102)
  • Ideas: a stopped build shows a red warning on its stage bar, and the builder no longer stops over branch names (#99)
  • Chat is on the new screens: ask a question or have data analysed, with the same accounts, models and connectors (#98)
  • Releases: the Windows build runs on its own after each release, so Mac releases stop waiting half an hour for it [skip release] (#89)
  • Formula for Windows builds again: resumed-run records use the portable crypto import [skip release] (#97)
  • Setup: first-time setup, the tools agents can use and the this-computer checklist are on the new screens (#96)
  • Ideas: builds on the Mac get their packages up front, a dropped connection carries on, and small ideas skip planning (#94)
